summary: Rainier Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a private placement of 5,625 units to its sponsor for $56,250, concurrently with the exercise of the IPO over-allotment. No underwriting discounts were paid; securities were issued under Section 4(a)(2). This is a routine SPAC capital-raising event, not a special-situation transaction. The filing also updates other events related to the IPO. Watch for the company's subsequent business combination announcement, which would constitute a special situation.
